name: Ladder: CalendarConnected
summary: CalendarConnectedMsg, wire 0x40a, type index 1034, a member of the client's CoatlicueClientMessages set. A 76-byte server-to-client record whose 72-byte body is a 4-byte tag, 32 unnamed bytes and a 36-byte run that is byte-identical in 0x1be and inside 0x65c. The capture sends it once, after the ping and before the self-identification record.
purpose: Tell the client the calendar service is connected. The name comes from the type table, so what the record does to client state is not established; its place in the ladder is measured.

created_when: the client has accepted the registration response and is waiting for its identity
lifecycle.if_absent: unmeasured. The record is one of the three the capture sends before the self-identification record that this server did not send at all.

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): the type marker followed by the prefix varint 8a 10 = 1034 = 0x40a, so the 72-byte body below starts at record offset 0x04.

fields.note: Measured 0x14786158 (bytes 58 61 78 14), a virtual address into the image's .rdata. The same 4 bytes sit at the head of 0x1be and at record offset 0x15 in 0x65c.

It is byte-identical in 0x1be and is the same 36 bytes 0x65c carries at record offset 0x39, so it names a shared object that nobody has identified; a server that composes messages has to keep it consistent.
